title: Create a temporary file with a custom prefix
summary: Create a temporary file that starts with a specific name you choose, followed by random characters. This helps identify the file's purpose.

steps.explain: Use the -t flag followed by your desired prefix. mktemp will create a file starting with this prefix and append random characters to ensure uniqueness.

placeholders.name: PREFIX
placeholders.description: The starting name for the temporary file

steps.expect: The absolute path to the new temporary file, e.g., /var/folders/.../mytest.XXXXXXXX
